audit/summary.json.spec: WNR3-DRAFT-v2.1 section 11 T3 (+ 5.8 TAIL profile gate)

config.model: models/even.npz:fg_a0_K0_c0 (ceil-ref, trained on the 80 even-index experts)

case_doc.W0: clean weight streams (control: all must be accepted, identical output)
case_doc.A: team2 A: one random bit flip anywhere in a weight stream (state bytes included)
case_doc.B: team2 B: bit flip in the last byte of a weight stream
case_doc.C: team2 C: bit flip in the 4-byte initial state
case_doc.E: team2 E: zero-fill from a random offset (>= 4) to the stream end (torn write)
case_doc.G: team2 G: length + 1 (one extra random byte)
case_doc.H: team2 H: valid stream decoded at the next index (next stream srel and identity, own length)
case_doc.I: team2 I: valid stream at the next index with IDENTICAL contexts (own srel), identity of the next index
case_doc.J: team2 J: valid stream decoded with another matrix type model (w1->w3, w2->w3, w3->w1)
case_doc.T: tail magnitude change: valid re-encode with one magnitude changed in the last 5 symbols, integrity field of the ORIGINAL data (stale hash); for R0 and TAIL accepted by construction
case_doc.M2: length-table corruption, sum preserving: boundary between adjacent weight streams shifted by +-1..8 bytes
case_doc.N1: swapped adjacent weight streams (bytes and lengths consistent)
case_doc.N2: swapped weight streams j <-> random k
case_doc.N3: weight stream of another record (other expert, same index and kind)
case_doc.K: random single bit flip in a scale stream (5 passes over all scale streams)
case_doc.L: bit flip in the last byte of a scale stream (2 passes)
case_doc.M3: scale length boundary shift between adjacent scale streams (+-1..4 bytes)
case_doc.N5: scale stream of another record (same index)
case_doc.M1: record level: random bit flip in the LENC length section
case_doc.P2: record level: torn write, zero from a random offset in the used region to the end
case_doc.P3: record level: last k = 1..4 payload bytes zeroed
case_doc.O: record level: whole valid record decoded in another expert slot (layer/expert binding)

audit/summary.json.pass_rule: PASS = H32 self test, clean records byte-exact (own + ceil-ref decoder), W0/S0 controls all accepted identical, no case errors, 0 silent acceptances for every strong rule (HASH, HASH32, TAILD) in every case, record-level cross-check agrees. R0 and TAIL-alone acceptance and damage are reported, not gated. DONE = nothing failed but a gate was not run.
